def-pe04-one-dimensional-interval-mesh-a:
## Definition

Let $a<b$ and choose an integer $N\ge1$ and points
$$a=x_0<x_1<\cdots<x_N=b.$$
The **oriented interval mesh** is the ordered family of cells $I_j=(x_{j-1},x_j)$, $1\le j\le N$, each oriented from left to right. Write $h_j=x_j-x_{j-1}>0$. For an integer $p\ge0$, the **broken polynomial space** is
$$V_h^{\mathrm{br}}=\prod_{j=1}^N\mathbb P_p(I_j),$$
with functions interpreted cell by cell. At an interior node $x_j$, write $w^-_j=w|_{I_j}(x_j)$ for the trace from the left cell and $w^+_j=w|_{I_{j+1}}(x_j)$ for the trace from the right cell; the chosen face normal points from left to right, and the jump is $[w]_j=w^+_j-w^-_j$. At $a$ and $b$, the outward normals are $-1$ and $+1$, respectively.

The published matching-affine-simplicial-mesh convention used elsewhere on the A page has dimension $d\ge2$. This definition supplies the distinct one-dimensional interval and trace convention; it makes no assertion about multidimensional cells.
def-pe04-diagonal-norm-sbp-element-data:
## Definition

On an affine element in dimension $d\ge1$, diagonal-norm SBP data consist of a nodal state vector with $N_K$ entries, a positive diagonal matrix $H_K\in\mathbb R^{N_K\times N_K}$, and derivative matrices $D_{K,\ell}$, $1\le\ell\le d$. Put $Q_{K,\ell}=H_KD_{K,\ell}$. For each face $F$ let $R_{K,F}$ select its face nodes from the volume nodes, let $M_{K,F}$ be a positive diagonal face quadrature matrix, and let $n_{K,F}$ be its constant outward unit normal. The data are **SBP compatible** when
$$D_{K,\ell}\mathbf1=0,\qquad R_{K,F}\mathbf1=\mathbf1_F,\qquad Q_{K,\ell}+Q_{K,\ell}^{T}=\sum_{F\subset\partial K} n_{K,F,\ell}R_{K,F}^{T}M_{K,F}R_{K,F}$$
for each coordinate $\ell$. The rows of $R_{K,F}$ select the nodes used by the face quadrature; on an interior face, the two cells have the same face nodes and weights under the face identification and opposite normals. In dimension one, $R_L$ and $R_R$ select the left and right endpoint nodes with normals $-1$ and $+1$.

This is conditional algebraic data: the definition does not assert that every mesh has such a rule. The identities include exact affine metric factors and no curved-element metric approximation.
alg-pe04-first-order-upwind-forward-eule:
## Definition

Let $d\ge2$, let $\mathcal T_h$ be a finite matching affine simplicial mesh whose boundary faces are paired by translations to form a periodic mesh, let $V_K=\int_K1\,dx$ be cell volume, and let $A_F=\int_F1\,dS$ be face area. Let $\beta\in\mathbb R^d$ be constant, and let $U_K\in\mathbb R$ be one cell mean per cell. For each face $F\subset\partial K$, let $n_{K,F}$ be the outward unit normal, $b_{K,F}=\beta\cdot n_{K,F}$, and $K_F$ the neighboring cell across that periodic face. With $b^+=\max(b,0)$ and $b^- =\min(b,0)$, the upwind flux out of $K$ is
$$\widehat f_{K,F}=b_{K,F}^+U_K+b_{K,F}^-U_{K_F}.$$
For a step $\Delta t>0$, first compute
$$\lambda_K=\frac{\Delta t}{V_K}\sum_{F\subset\partial K}A_Fb_{K,F}^+.$$
The **degree-zero upwind forward-Euler update** is admissible when $\lambda_K\le1$ for every cell; its output is
$$U_K^+=U_K-\frac{\Delta t}{V_K}\sum_{F\subset\partial K}A_F\widehat f_{K,F}.$$
This is the degree-zero specialization of [[def-pe04-upwind-dg-transport-discretization]].
def-pe04-cellwise-l2-projection:
## Definition

Let $K$ be a cell in the one-dimensional interval or $d\ge2$ matching affine-simplex branch of [[def-pe04-upwind-dg-transport-discretization]], and fix an integer degree $p\ge0$. Let $(K,\mathcal A,\mu)$ be a finite measure space as in [[def-measure-space]], let $\mathcal L^2(\mu)$ have the raw measurable-function meaning of [[def-calligraphic-l-p-on-a-measure-space]], and let $W=\mathbb P_p(K)\subseteq\mathcal L^2(\mu)$. For $u\in\mathcal L^2(\mu)$ define its **cellwise L2 projection relation** to be the set
$$\mathcal P_K(u)=\left\{p\in\mathbb P_p(K):\int_K(u-p)w\,d\mu=0\text{ for every }w\in\mathbb P_p(K)\right\}.$$
For a mesh, the broken relation is the product of these cell relations. The measure $\mu$ is required to give positive measure to every nonempty relatively open subset of $K$ when existence and uniqueness are claimed. This definition does not itself assert that the set is a singleton. Whenever a later result proves that the relation has a unique member, write $\Pi_Ku$ for that member.
def-pe04-upwind-sbp-sat-transport-discre:
## Definition

Fix constant transport velocity $\beta\in\mathbb R^d$ and SBP data from [[def-pe04-diagonal-norm-sbp-element-data]]. For each cell $K$, let $U_K(t)$ be the vector of nodal values, $Q_{K,\ell}=H_KD_{K,\ell}$, and $U_{K,F}=R_{K,F}U_K$. Set $b_{K,F}=\beta\cdot n_{K,F}$. At each interior face, use the trace from the cell with positive outward speed when $b_{K,F}>0$, and the neighboring trace when $b_{K,F}<0$; at boundary faces use the inflow data on $b_{K,F}<0$ and the interior trace on $b_{K,F}\ge0$. Denote this upwind scalar trace by $\widehat U_{K,F}$.

The **upwind SBP-SAT semidiscretization** is
$$H_K\dot U_K+\sum_{\ell=1}^d\beta_\ell Q_{K,\ell}U_K+\sum_{F\subset\partial K}R_{K,F}^{T}M_{K,F}\,b_{K,F}(\widehat U_{K,F}-U_{K,F})=0.$$
The sign of the SAT correction is fixed by this equation. The definition is spatial only and makes no fully discrete claim.
thm-pe04-upwind-dg-l2-energy-stability:
## Statement

Let $d\ge2$, let $\Omega$ have a finite matching affine simplicial mesh, let $\beta\in\mathbb R^d$ be constant, and let $u_h$ solve [[def-pe04-upwind-dg-transport-discretization]] with inflow data $g$. Assume Countable Choice, as required by the affine-simplex Green supplier. Write $\Gamma_+=\{x\in\partial\Omega:\beta\cdot n>0\}$ and $\Gamma_- =\{x\in\partial\Omega:\beta\cdot n<0\}$. For an interior facet $F=K^-\cap K^+$ choose a unit normal $n_F$ from $K^-$ to $K^+$ and write $[u_h]=u_h^+-u_h^-$. Then
$$\frac12\frac{d}{dt}\sum_{K\in\mathcal T_h}\|u_h\|_{L^2(K)}^2+\frac12\sum_{F\text{ interior}}\int_F|\beta\cdot n_F|[u_h]^2\,dS+\frac12\int_{\Gamma_+}(\beta\cdot n)u_h^2\,dS+\frac12\int_{\Gamma_-}|\beta\cdot n|(u_h-g)^2\,dS=\frac12\int_{\Gamma_-}|\beta\cdot n|g^2\,dS.$$
In particular, zero inflow data give a nonincreasing semidiscrete $L^2$ norm. This result is semidiscrete and makes no claim about a time integrator.
def-pe04-flux-differencing-sbp-systems:
## Definition

Let $d\ge2$, let $\mathcal T_h$ be a finite matching affine simplicial mesh, and consider $U_t+\sum_{\ell=1}^d\partial_{x_\ell}F_\ell(U)=0$ with state domain $\mathcal A\subseteq\mathbb R^m$. Assume a common convex entropy $\eta$ and, for each direction $\ell$, an entropy flux $q_\ell$ so that $(\eta,q_\ell)$ satisfies [[def-pe03-system-entropy-pair-and-potential]] for the directional flux $F_\ell$. Write $v=\nabla\eta$ and $\psi_\ell=v^TF_\ell-q_\ell$. For every direction, supply a symmetric consistent two-point flux $F_\ell^{ec}$ satisfying [[def-pe03-tadmor-entropy-conservative-flux]], namely
$$\bigl(v(U_R)-v(U_L)\bigr)^TF_\ell^{ec}(U_L,U_R)=\psi_\ell(U_R)-\psi_\ell(U_L).$$

On each cell use diagonal-norm SBP data from [[def-pe04-diagonal-norm-sbp-element-data]]. Put $Q_{K,\ell}=H_KD_{K,\ell}$; let $U_i^K\in\mathcal A$ be the nodal states; and let the face restrictions select paired face nodes with matching positive weights on the two incident cells. For an oriented interior face node with normal $n$ from the minus trace to the plus trace, set $F_n(U)=\sum_\ell n_\ell F_\ell(U)$ and $\psi_n(U)=\sum_\ell n_\ell\psi_\ell(U)$. Given any fixed coefficient $\alpha_{F,q}\ge0$, define the normal interface flux
$$\widehat F_{n,F,q}^*(U^-,U^+)=\sum_{\ell=1}^d n_\ell F_\ell^{ec}(U^-,U^+)-\frac{\alpha_{F,q}}2\bigl(v(U^+)-v(U^-)\bigr).$$
The coefficient is the same when the face orientation is reversed. Thus the flux is conservative and consistent, and its entropy contraction is
$$[v]^T\widehat F_{n,F,q}^*=[\psi_n]-\frac{\alpha_{F,q}}2\lVert[v]\rVert^2\le[\psi_n],$$
by the directional Tadmor identities in [[def-pe03-tadmor-entropy-conservative-flux]]. On physical boundary faces supply a consistent normal flux and require the boundary entropy contribution below to be nonnegative.

Write $\omega_{F,q}$ for the $q$th diagonal entry of $M_F$. Define the boundary entropy contribution
$$\mathcal B_h(t)=\sum_{F\subset\partial\Omega}\sum_q\omega_{F,q}\bigl(v(U_{F,q})^T\widehat F_{n_F}^*-\psi_{n_F}(U_{F,q})\bigr).$$
The selected boundary flux is entropy admissible when $\mathcal B_h(t)\ge0$. The **flux-differencing SBP semidiscretization** on each element is
$$H_K\dot U^K+2\sum_{\ell=1}^d\bigl(Q_{K,\ell}\circ F_\ell^{ec}(U^K,U^K)\bigr)\mathbf1+\sum_{F\subset\partial K}R_{K,F}^TM_{K,F}\bigl(\widehat F_{n_{K,F}}^*-F_{n_{K,F}}(U_{K,F})\bigr)=0,$$
where $\circ$ is entrywise matrix multiplication and $F_\ell^{ec}(U^K,U^K)$ is the matrix with $(i,j)$ entry $F_\ell^{ec}(U_i^K,U_j^K)$. These are conditional method data: compatible SBP data and directional entropy-conservative fluxes are hypotheses, not asserted to exist for every mesh or entropy pair. The interior numerical flux is explicitly defined once those data and $\alpha_{F,q}$ are supplied. Curved elements are excluded.
lem-pe04-cellwise-l2-projection-exists-b:
## Statement

For every finite measure $\mu$ on a bounded nondegenerate interval or nondegenerate affine simplex $K$ that assigns positive measure to every nonempty relatively open subset, every $p\ge0$, and every $u\in\mathcal L^2(\mu)$, the set $\mathcal P_K(u)$ in [[def-pe04-cellwise-l2-projection]] contains exactly one polynomial $\Pi_Ku$. For each $w\in\mathbb P_p(K)$,
$$\|u-\Pi_Ku\|_{L^2(K)}\le\|u-w\|_{L^2(K)}.$$
thm-pe04-first-order-upwind-forward-eule:
## Statement

Let $\mathcal T_h$ be a finite periodic matching affine simplicial mesh in $d\ge2$, let $\beta\in\mathbb R^d$ be constant, and apply [[alg-pe04-first-order-upwind-forward-euler]] with $\lambda_K\le1$ for every cell. Assume Countable Choice for the imported affine-simplex Green formula. Then the cell-volume-weighted mean is conserved:
$$\sum_KV_KU_K^+=\sum_KV_KU_K.$$
For every convex function $\eta:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, the weighted discrete entropy does not increase:
$$\sum_KV_K\eta(U_K^+)\le\sum_KV_K\eta(U_K).$$
thm-pe04-upwind-sbp-sat-l2-energy-stabil:
## Statement

Assume the one-dimensional upwind SBP-SAT method of [[def-pe04-upwind-sbp-sat-transport-discretization]] on a finite interval mesh with constant speed $a>0$, diagonal positive norms, one endpoint node per face, unit endpoint face weights, and matching endpoints. Let $U_{K,L}$ and $U_{K,R}$ denote the endpoint values of a cell, and let $[U]_F=U^+_F-U^-_F$ at an interior node. For inflow data $g$, the discrete energy $E_h=\frac12\sum_K U_K^TH_KU_K$ satisfies
$$\frac{dE_h}{dt}+\frac a2\sum_{F\text{ interior}}[U]_F^2+\frac a2U_{\mathrm{out}}^2+\frac a2(U_{\mathrm{in}}-g)^2=\frac a2g^2$$
on a finite interval mesh with its single inflow and single outflow boundary. Hence zero inflow data give a nonincreasing SBP norm.
thm-pe04-dg-smooth-solution-l2-error-bou:
## Statement

Let $d\ge2$, let $\mathcal T_h$ be a finite matching affine simplicial mesh, let $\beta\in\mathbb R^d$ be constant, and let $u\in C^1([0,T]\times\overline\Omega)$ solve $u_t+\beta\cdot\nabla u=0$ with inflow data equal to its boundary trace. Assume Countable Choice for the imported affine-simplex Green identity and the full-support fact for Lebesgue measure. Let $u_h$ be the semidiscrete upwind DG solution of degree $p\ge0$, and let $\Pi_h$ be the cellwise L2 projection with respect to Lebesgue measure on each cell. Use $\|w\|_{L^2(\Omega)}^2=\sum_K\int_K|w|^2\,dx$ and put $\eta=\Pi_hu-u$. For an interior face with chosen normal $n_F$, let $\eta^{\mathrm{up}}$ be the trace of $\eta$ from the upwind side, and define
$$R_h(t)^2=\sum_{F\text{ interior}}\int_F|\beta\cdot n_F|\,|\eta^{\mathrm{up}}|^2\,dS+\int_{\Gamma_+}(\beta\cdot n)|\eta|^2\,dS.$$
Then
$$\|u_h(T)-u(T)\|_{L^2(\Omega)}\le\left(\|u_h(0)-\Pi_hu(0)\|_{L^2(\Omega)}^2+2\int_0^TR_h(t)^2\,dt\right)^{1/2}+\|\Pi_hu(T)-u(T)\|_{L^2(\Omega)}.$$
This is an exact projection-trace residual bound. It asserts no mesh-order rate unless the displayed projection errors are separately estimated.
thm-pe04-flux-differencing-sbp-conservat:
## Statement

Assume the affine-element method and all directional entropy/SBP data of [[def-pe04-flux-differencing-sbp-systems]]. Suppose all nodal states remain in $\mathcal A$. Define the discrete entropy and the boundary contribution by
$$E_h(t)=\sum_{K\in\mathcal T_h}\mathbf1^TH_K\eta(U^K),\qquad \mathcal B_h(t)=\sum_{F\subset\partial\Omega}\sum_q\omega_{F,q}\bigl(v(U_{F,q})^T\widehat F_{n_F}^*-\psi_{n_F}(U_{F,q})\bigr).$$
If $\mathcal B_h(t)\ge0$, then
$$\frac{d}{dt}E_h(t)+\sum_{F\text{ interior}}\sum_q\omega_{F,q}\frac{\alpha_{F,q}}2\lVert[v]_{F,q}\rVert^2+\mathcal B_h(t)=0,$$
so $E_h$ is nonincreasing. Here $\widehat F_{n_F,q}^*$ is the explicitly defined normal flux of [[def-pe04-flux-differencing-sbp-systems]]. On a periodic mesh the boundary contribution cancels with its identified periodic partner. The same semidiscretization conserves the quadrature-weighted total state on a periodic mesh. No fully discrete entropy statement follows.
thm-pe04-ssprk33-first-order-upwind-entr:
## Statement

Let $\mathcal T_h$ be a finite periodic matching affine simplicial mesh, write $V_K=\int_K1\,dx>0$ for its cell volumes, let $\beta$ be constant, and let $\eta:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be convex. Assume the cellwise forward-Euler condition in [[thm-pe04-first-order-upwind-forward-euler-conservation-and-entropy]] holds for $\Delta t$, including its Countable Choice premise through the affine-simplex Green formula. For the autonomous degree-zero upwind DG ODE, write $E_{\Delta t}(U)=U+\Delta t L_h(U)$. The exact SSPRK(3,3) recurrence is
$$Y_1=E_{\Delta t}(U^n),\qquad Y_2=\frac34U^n+\frac14E_{\Delta t}(Y_1),\qquad U^{n+1}=\frac13U^n+\frac23E_{\Delta t}(Y_2).$$
Then $\sum_KV_K\eta(U_K^{n+1})\le\sum_KV_K\eta(U_K^n)$. This guarantee is for the degree-zero scalar upwind operator just specified; it is not a fully discrete entropy theorem for the high-order nonlinear flux-differencing SBP method.
